speaker: Doctor
text:
That is an unusual combination of symptoms. Can you tell me exactly when the fever started relative to finishing your antibiotics, and has the pain moved from your back to your abdomen?

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis
REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis - Leukocyturia: Present; Bacterial_Culture: Negative; Cytospin_Stained_With_Hansel's_Solution: 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm. Blood_Culture: NORMAL READINGS.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The presence of binucleated eosinophils in your urine is highly suggestive of Acute Interstitial Nephritis, which is often triggered by antibiotics. Did you take any medications for the sinusitis other than the primary antibiotic, and have you noticed any rash or joint pain recently?

REQUEST TEST: Kidney_Function_Tests
REQUEST IMAGES: Renal_Ultrasound

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Kidney_Function_Tests: Serum_Biochemistry - Urea: Elevated, Creatinine: Elevated. Renal_Ultrasound: NORMAL READINGS.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the results; the elevated urea and creatinine confirm acute kidney injury, and the normal ultrasound helps rule out obstruction or stones. Did you experience any itching, swelling of your face or hands, or a rash while taking those antibiotics? Also, have you had any recent exposure to high doses of NSAIDs for your pain?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis secondary to antibiotic use.
